[1] Get Your Phil is the sixth studio album released by Disappear Fear.
[2] Playing the Angel is the eleventh studio album by the English electronic music band Depeche Mode, released on 17 October 2005 in the UK by Mute Records and on 18 October in the United States, Mexico and Canada by Sire Records and Reprise Records.
[3] "Fragile Tension"/"Hole to Feed" is Depeche Mode's third single from their studio album, "Sounds of the Universe", their 48th UK single overall, and their third double A-side single, following "Blasphemous Rumours / Somebody" and "John the Revelator / Lilian".
[4] "John the Revelator"/"Lilian" is the second double A-side single by Depeche Mode and their forty-fourth single overall, released on 5 June 2006.
